Similarly, JPM reports a decline in its Home Lending segment, explicitly attributing it to paydowns and loan sales outpacing originations.

comparisons.peer_topic: Sources of Credit Risk in Wealth Management
comparisons.peer_summary: The Wealth Management business segment incurs credit risk primarily through lending to individuals and entities, including margin loans, securities-based lending, single-family residential mortgage loans, and employee loans.
comparisons.comparison: Both BAC and MS disclose the inclusion of single-family residential mortgage loans within their respective consumer or wealth management lending portfolios. BAC details that its residential mortgage portfolio is distributed primarily between Consumer Banking (50%) and GWIM (47%). MS identifies single-family residential mortgage loans (in conforming, non-conforming, or HELOC form) as a key source of credit risk in its Wealth Management segment, primarily extended to existing clients.
